name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments to small and marginal farmer families.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year (Rs 2,000 every 4 months) directly to bank account.
apply_at: Common Service Center (CSC) or PM Kisan Portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)
description: Financial assistance to rural homeless and kutcha house dwellers to construct pucca houses.
benefits: Rs 1,20,000 in plains and Rs 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas.
apply_at: Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office

name: National Food Security Act (Ration Card)
description: Subsidised food grains through the Public Distribution System for eligible households.
benefits: 5 kg of food grains (rice/wheat) per person per month at subsidised rates. AAY families get 35 kg per month.
apply_at: District Food & Supply Office or CSC

name: UP Old Age / Disability / Widow Pension
description: Monthly pension for senior citizens (60+), disabled persons, and widows living below poverty line in Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: Rs 500 per month pension directly to bank account.
apply_at: Block Development Office or online at sspy-up.gov.in

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing coverage of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
benefits: Rs 5,00,000 health cover per family per year. Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.
apply_at: Empanelled hospital or CSC or pmjay.gov.in

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Free LPG gas connection to women from BPL households to reduce dependence on traditional cooking fuel.
benefits: Free LPG connection with one free cylinder. Subsidised refills.

name: UP Scholarship (Pre & Post Matric)
description: Scholarships for students from OBC, SC, ST, and minority communities studying in UP for pre and post matric classes.
benefits: Annual scholarship amount varies by class and category (Rs 3,000 to Rs 12,000+). Maintenance allowance included.

name: MGNREGA (100 Days Employment Guarantee)
description: Provides at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: 100 days guaranteed employment at minimum wages (Rs 213/day in UP). Wages paid directly to bank account.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
description: UP government scheme to improve health, education, and social status of girl child through financial assistance at six stages of life.
benefits: Total Rs 15,000 in 6 installments from birth to graduation.

name: PM SVAMITVA Yojana
description: Mapping of land in rural inhabited areas using drone technology and providing 'Record of Rights' to village household owners.
benefits: Legal property card (Adhikar Patra) enabling use of property as financial asset for loans.
